notes.title: Ploughs and cars won't bug out anymore!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=khKhwdtjzTY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]☃️ Hey snow fans! ❄️🌨️[/h1] 

[h2]Today a surprise! To celebrate the Steam Spring Sale, we have prepared for you the first of two updates. Today one, next week - the bigger one 😎⛷️ 
Let's get started ❗️[/h2]

❗️❗️[b]*The UPDATE comes from our game being in Early Access, link below:[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2096030/Snow_Plowing_Simulator/
[b]I encourage you to try the full game, not just the DEMO you have the opportunity to play here. Our EA version is definitely better and we have now 20% off*[/b]❗️❗️

[h1]🚜Improving vehicles even more🚗 + ploughs improvement📶[/h1]
[b]This time I focused on a very important aspect of Snow Plowing, namely vehicles and plows. In this version you get a completely rebuilt system. I did the first update of vehicles in January and it was warmly received by you, while some of you still reported problems. This update should put an end to that ☀️

Maybe from your side as players the changes are cosmetic, but actually there are more than 300 changes in the game code!

Now all plows work OK (the 'V' shaped one too!), vehicles no longer jump up on the roads, plows adjust to the terrain - but if the angle at which you try to clear the snow is too high there is a crash.
Weather also now has a stronger effect on vehicle driving (on universal tires driving on ice is only for masochists - check our video above🎦).

I also corrected some minor bugs.
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/75d37fbd0955229855799950a98d2f2874c7bddd.jpg[/img]

[h1]
Remember☃️- this is just a first update in March, look out for the real news in a WEEK! 🔥 Check our last roadmap too 🔁[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2096030/view/532092240505342148?l=english


❗️ Remember - Snow Plowing is still in Early Access. Gameplay errors can happen! Therefore, we look forward to your feedback. Most bugs are being fixed thanks to your reports ❗️


[b]How to contact us with bugs?
Do it via discord 📢[/b]
https://discord.gg/76N77uHWkc

[b]Or via the Steam discussion📢[/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2096030/discussions/0/

[b]How to support Snow Plowing Simulator?
The easiest way is to share your opinion of our game with others on Steam or among your friends. Thank you very much💗

Love You
SPS Team
[/b]

notes.title: ☃️Survey results finally available!🕵
notes.content:
[h1]☃️Hey snow fans!❄️🌨️[/h1] 

❗️❗️[b]*The survey comes from our game being in Early Access, link below:[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2096030/Snow_Plowing_Simulator/
[b]I encourage you to try the full game, not just the DEMO you have the opportunity to play here. Our EA version is definitely better*[/b]❗️❗️

[h3]For the past few months, you have helped us by completing the survey for Snow Plowing.

We are extremely grateful to you! We must admit that the results were surprising to us - but only in the positive sense. 227 responses to such a detailed survey and your activity in the open questions - we are very impressed by your activity and helpːsteamhappyː

THANK YOU❗️❤️So what do you say about starting the analysis? Let's go❗️

[/h3]

[h1]1.Game system📶[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/05dccff65593e32d2ceaefe8ff0ae12f4f70df09.jpg[/img]
[b]The majority of players are against solutions that can hinder gameplay. This is why we choose not to introduce the possibility of carrying a single tool⛔️
[/b]

[h1]⬇️[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/c49c8499de771d63a05ccc7ffc51e0cf1a9a0708.jpg[/img]
[b]By the same token, we are abandoning thieves in gameplay⛔️[/b]

[h1]⬇️[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/2ff65995f5389e24c5b0199c3194d11be20be47e.jpg[/img]
[b]As for the issue of owning your own home - we will consider introducing this. The feedback is rather neutral/positive✅[/b]

[h1]⬇️[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/dcebdf1c59f18847775dcfa1b69cdf01dce8111a.jpg[/img]
[b]The next question was open for your completion (question related to the previous). We are inserting a link for you to view the answers for yourself:[/b]
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/17fOmyy_D4LhkBwIxdZ3wqFl59PhHGJsXl_KtZktMuis/viewanalytics
[b]According to our analysis, what you expect most in home is: a resting place, the possibility to personalise your home, food storage with tools and vehicles, but also new mechanics like a weather forecast on TV. 

This sounds very cool :) Before the introduction, we will analyse all the answers again to select the most important aspects.[/b]

[h1]⬇️[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/11c6742058aba699e733b33b59dc40624da2f0d4.jpg[/img]
[b]The idea of running a company caused mixed feelings. Some people are in favour, some are not. We are sceptical about this solution and will probably not introduce it ⚠️[/b]

As a curiosity, you can check your answers about running a business:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/17fOmyy_D4LhkBwIxdZ3wqFl59PhHGJsXl_KtZktMuis/viewanalytics


[h1]⬇️⛷️🏂[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/fa7aa39e5d4466327427ad2cfcbae52a5db51ae5.jpg[/img]
[b]In the ski resort question, on the other hand, you were very much in agreement - the majority of you are in favour of the idea. In that case, we can confirm to you - we will introduce such an update!🎿✅[/b]

[h1]⬇️👽[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/150d62812ab6a7354d1fc7d992720ceed788a235.jpg[/img]
You are also rather in favour of introducing more plot threads. Therefore - this is what we will do!👾🛰️✅

[h1]2.🛠️New items to buy📞[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/42f9f3be268da03f2b4cc39f2c53ccf874912788.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/661743a7738692e2a70ec85718d88715c01dc0b7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/9e3b8f522b5482d471bb841bec00cbe2bbe8deea.jpg[/img]

[b]In the tools section - we'll definitely let go of the flamethrower, but probably also the camera or radio - it's not a priority for you⛔️

We will definitely introduce a salt and sand spreader! So will navigation and mobile phone✅

The other things we are in favour of, while we prioritise the things that are most on the very important/important
[/b]

[h1]⬇️[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/cea0c7bbcbc971c7cf10382827142c6e62d607eb.jpg[/img]
[b]You are most in favour of new vehicles and new ploughs. Then that's the direction we'll be going in!✅

More details can be found in the open questions at the link I pasted above.
[/b]

[h1]3.🚞Vehicles🚗[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/a70ef57b80ba27411ff4c554b18fac348d46a5ee.jpg[/img]
[b]You care most about manoeuvrability and vehicle suspension. I include the question as a curiosity because after the last January update the driving has been fixed!🔧 We will think about other things like colour change and changing speed.

There are also open questions in the survey, which I recommend reading. You point out, among other things, support for controllers and steering wheels - we promise to introduce this in next months!🕹️
[/b]

[h1]⬇️🚜🛤️[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/ce185763979d36fe17ec6ad6ad106802eda32e37.jpg[/img]
[b]And here's a surprise for you - the trailer will be introduced for an update in March![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778142/755422337942d7c5be1057858b5495f3a708eb62.jpg[/img]
[h1]⬇️[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/946b3011be826b34e37f3223b2662b206f6c1cbb.jpg[/img]
[b]Collision of vehicles and refueling vehicles is unlikely to be introduced⛔️[/b]

[h1]⬇️[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/c11b665c22f5607271e9c2db2f506191c11add8c.jpg[/img]
[b]We will consider the introduction of expensive teleports to reduce the time it takes to move between locations. We are keen not to knock you out of the immersion experience, so either expensive💸 or not at all⛔️

The rest of your opinions from the open question are in the survey. You focus on improving driving physics (this has already been fixed), increasing warning lights, more vehicles and customisation, also criticising teleports and wanting to introduce GPS.
[/b]

[h1]4.🔩Technicalities⚙️ [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/cf0949db70cb94805a893588a490d8c7df2739c1.jpg[/img]
[b]You are in favour of introducing multiple save slots, but also of adding achivements. In addition, you want to fix the appearance of snow, which is still sometimes buggy🛠️[/b]

[h1]⬇️[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/8b171e34ec517a02cdc23a4953ab28e3336d6ebc.jpg[/img]
[b]In addition, we intend to introduce the possibility of using a pad, as I mentioned earlier. You also care about further improving performance↗️[/b]

[h1]⬇️[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/3d78922626140a261e9d8f8c978444cb53fea502.jpg[/img]
[b]In the last section of the open-text question you focus on:
- the possibility of viewing the aurora borealis, constellations
- additional activities such as rescuing cars from snowdrifts, clearing snow from railway tracks
- different types of snow such as powder, ice and slush
- more NPCs, better sound
- possibility to work with AI, more NPCs
- introduction of additional statistics
- more artefacts, finds, easter-eggs
- Steam Deck configuration

Thank you for your suggestions - this is the part that caught our eye. Read the rest for yourself! We are, of course, analysing everything you have reported to us.
[/b]

[h1]❤️👩‍🚀Now we're getting to work - and preparing a new update for you. Thank you again - YOU ARE OUR HEROES!👨‍🚀❤️[/h1]



❗️Remember - Snow Plowing is still in Early Access. Gameplay errors can happen! Therefore, we look forward to your feedback. Most bugs are being fixed thanks to your reports❗️


[b]How to contact us with bugs?
Do it via discord 📢[/b]
https://discord.gg/76N77uHWkc

[b]Or via the Steam discussion📢[/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2096030/discussions/0/

[b]How to support Snow Plowing Simulator?
The easiest way is to share your opinion of our game with others on Steam or among your friends. Thank you very much💗

Love You
SPS Team
[/b]

notes.title: Prologue vs Full Game
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Snow Plowers![/h3]
From time to time I will tell you about the differences between the prologue🔒 and the ❄️[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2096030/Snow_Plowing_Simulator/]full version[/url] ❄️.

First thing's first - straight for the impatient ones🔥

This is what the truck looks like parked 🏭 and ready (almost 🚧) for work! It is available in the ❄️[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2096030/Snow_Plowing_Simulator/]full game[/url] ❄️, although it requires some work🛠️ and lacks proper efficient plows.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778142/fe382958f7b2509e3044c477413bcc698f2c079a.jpg[/img]

Ah🤦‍♂️! I mentioned plows. I know you can't wait 👀 to be able to mount the plow to your pickup truck and start clearing snow with this set!
Here they are:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778142/0f4976f1a89c8ca8444802e2f1cb206a8d9ccc20.jpg[/img]

The mechanics of buying plows, putting them on, taking them off are ready! 💪💪💪

[previewyoutube=JjnwR8sbkho;full][UsePlow.mp4 ][/previewyoutube]

It's worse with the snow removal itself, and having learned that you shouldn't share unfinished 🏗️🛠️ products 🚧 I will only show you what snow removal looks like at the moment (to give you a taste for ❄️ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/ 2096030/Snow_Plowing_Simulator/]full version[/url]) ❄️:

[previewyoutube=jVwvbA8yAEE;full][PlowOnRoad.mp4][/previewyoutube]

And many of you asked 👀 if the game will be endless 🔁🔁🔁 . [b]Yes![/b] After all, the life of a snowblower 😫👨‍🏭 never ends, just like snowfall never ends 🌨️🌨️🌨️🌨️! Whenever snow 🌨️ falls, it will cover various parts of the land again. If it falls to the property level, you will be able to complete the order again and earn 🤑 a few pennies again. Only snowfall is unpredictable (👻👣👽☃️)

[previewyoutube=9i-37Wz6jNw;full][itsSnowing.mp4][/previewyoutube]

You also asked about additional items! Oh, there will be quite a few of them apart from the ones we have now! All you need to do is unlock the gas station!
❄️headlamp 🔦
❄️wheel chains ⛓️
❄️GPS for teleportation 🗺️
...and many others

[i]I hope I have encouraged you even more to add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2096030/Snow_Plowing_Simulator/]full version[/url] to your WishList.[/i]


Now I'm going back to 🎮 work,
[i]give me a few days for further patches[/i]

[i]~Arthur[/i]
[i]Lead Developer of Snow Plowing Simulator[/i]

notes.title: ❄️❄️Patch #1.1❄️❄️
notes.content:
Hello Snow Plowers!❄️❄️❄️
[b]Thank you very much for your interest and for so many downloads of the first patch![/b]

You really motivated me to work! ːsteamhappyː
In order not to disappoint you, I have prepared[b]a small fix[/b]in which you can finally[b] mute those unloved vehicle sounds![/b] I promise that [b]in the full game they will be refined to 1000%, [/b] but for now... just turn it down :) 🔕

I also moved it to the main menu and separated the ability to disable popups from the game mode[b]. [/b]Now, no matter what form of game you choose, whether you want [b]extreme hard work,[/b] 💪🏻💪🏻💪🏻 or just [b] for fun[/b] 🥳🥳🥳 you can do it regardless during the game [b]turn popups on and off![/b] I know some people will like it... ːsteamhappyː

[b]I also developed a new method of exiting vehicles, everything should now work as it should.
Remember that if you can't get out of the vehicle or get lost somewhere, you can always call roadside assistance or look at the map [key "J"].[/b] Both of these options will take you to the nearest road!

Once again, thank you very much for your comments, suggestions and help! ❄️❄️❄️
Together we will make a really [b]GREAT game![/b] 💪🏻

Arthur
[i]Snow Plowing Simulator Lead Programmer[/i]

notes.title: ❄️First Snow Patch #01❄️
notes.content:
Hello, Everyone! ❄️❄️❄️
[b]I'm very happy that you are with me and helping me find problems and errors!
[/b]
As I promised, I am trying to[b] listen carefully to your voices[/b] and I have just [b]prepared and uploaded the first patch for Snow Plowing Simulator: First Snow![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778142/9c67bdcaf6f9bdcdaddb46aebc63aec3ca250b54.png[/img][u][b]You will find in it:[/b][/u][list]
[*] you noticed that you want to chill and not worry about health and calories! Therefore, now when you launch a new game, [b]you can choose the option to disable this function! Have fun![/b] 🫶🏻
[*] many people were also annoyed by the constant pop-ups with information on what to do! I understand you well, I prefer to discover the game step by step instead of clicking on what the help tells me. The function of[b] disabling popups has just appeared for you.[/b] They are generated all the time, but they do not clutter the entertainment itself and go straight to the information (I). You can always access them by clicking the "I" button!
[*] some players also experienced problems with saving and reading the game. I analyzed everything and thanks to those who reported this error,[b] it was corrected![/b] Now all game settings are saved safely.
[*] you also reported that the snow height on some properties is too high and that sometimes the snow is too close to the scenography elements - [b]I have also corrected this.[/b][/list]
[b]That's all that appeared in the first patch! I'm still working on further corrections, but I treated the above ones as the most important![/b]

Next I will work on:
❄️improving the operation of the tractor plow, especially its snow collection
❄️getting out of vehicles because, as you say, it can be a source of problems
❄️improving the wheels on the pickup truck
❄️further work on optimization
❄️vehicle physics
❄️preparing tutorials on Steam that will guide you step by step on how to play

As soon as I deal with these first childhood mistakes :), [b]I will immediately write to you what will appear in the game compared to the prologue - because remember that the prologue does not show you everything!
[/b]
If you are satisfied with the game or this patch solves your problems - please let me know, maybe recommend the game to your friends, and maybe change your comment if you have changed your mind.

[b][u]Just a note for people reporting performance problems:[/u][/b]
I understand you very well and I sympathize that Snow Plowing Simulator does not work well enough on your computer. Unfortunately, snow mechanics, calculating snow-cleared surfaces, dynamic weather, etc. [b]require adequate computing power from the computer.[/b] Especially when it comes to the [b]graphics card.[/b] If your graphics are [b]weaker than suggested,[/b] try setting the settings to minimum and disabling other programs running in the background. If this doesn't help - I'm very sorry and I'm sorry about this. [b]But don't judge the game then - just write on the forum that the game simply didn't run on your device, and by leaving negative comments you are discouraging players who could enjoy playing Snow Plowing Simulator on their own device![/b]

Thank you for your help, time and feedback!
[b]Arthur,[/b]
[i]the Main Developer of Snow Plowing Simulator[/i]

The function of[b] disabling popups has just appeared for you.[/b] They are generated all the time, but they do not clutter the entertainment itself and go straight to the information (I). notes.content:
Hello everyone,

[h3]I'm Artur, a developer💻 of the ❄️Snow Plowing Simulator - First Snow❄️ and a main game. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778142/4c915c094893c972919e50f3e4c1b0d617be5556.jpg[/img]

💪Firstly [b]I want to thank everyone[/b] for taking the time to check my beloved game. I appreciate it.

😢Secondly, [b]I want to apologize[/b] for all the problems you are getting. Bugs, crashes, etc🐞. Well, it's a prologue but I know it should be better... and I am working day and night now to make it so you will have joy and relax while plowing the snow. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778142/1700c0b01ad11a126b87d1c5d63323cd13898237.png[/img]


[b][u]Now let's move to the main point of this announcement[/u][/b]❗️
[h3][b]Work on the patch is in progress! Tomorrow in the middle of the day the first patch should be available![/b][/h3]

[b]You will find:[/b]
[olist]
[*] ✅ Added option to disable sickness and drop calories for those who want to chill
[*] ✅ Added option to disable popups because some players have been taking them badly! Now you can choose whether you want to see them or immediately have them hide and be available under the information keys
[/olist]

😍Thanks to you we found out that the game mode in the settings is badly saved. we are just finishing fixing it.


[h3][b]Immediately everything goes to test if everything works and you will get a patch tomorrow![/b][/h3]


I've wanted just to ask you all to give me a leap of faith and I WILL DELIVER! If you have a bug/crash/glitch please write to me on 
➡️ Steam 
➡️ [url=https://discord.gg/YBVMXVCEAN]Discord[/url] https://discord.gg/YBVMXVCEAN or 
➡️ email me at arturhalaczkiewicz@gmail.com 
(the fastest would be discord). 

I really can't help if I do not know what was the problem.


All the best
Your dev.
